mintAuthority.summary: spUSDT is a Spark ERC-4626 savings wrapper with canonical local issuance on Ethereum and Arbitrum. Shares are minted only against deposited local USDT or USDT0 after each vault's deposit-cap check and inherit Tether USDT's reviewed issuer/multisig mint authority for base supply. Ethereum vault upgrades and cap changes flow through the Spark SubProxy and Sky's enforceable 48-hour DSPause path; Arbitrum vault administration flows through the Spark Receiver and zero-delay Spark Executor governance path.

controls.label: Spark Savings USDT vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 share accounting over deposited USDT; does not mint base USDT.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, the vault was an ERC1967 UUPS proxy with implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455 and zero admin and beacon slots. asset() returned USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE had one member, SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4.

controls.label: Spark Savings USDT Arbitrum vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 share accounting over deposited Arbitrum USDT0; the 250,000,000 USDT0 deposit cap bounds ordinary share issuance, and SETTER_ROLE/TAKER_ROLE operate reserve liquidity and rate settings rather than arbitrary share minting.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495303977 (2026-08-16 00:01:22 UTC), the Spark spUSDT V2 vault 0x45d91340b3b7b96985a72b5c678f7d9e8d664b62 resolved to implementation 0x282dafe8b97e2db5053761a4601ab2e1cb976318 with a zero EIP-1967 admin slot. asset() returned USDT0 0xfd086bc7cd5c481dcc9c85ebe478a1c0b69fcbb9 and the deposit cap was 250,000,000 USDT0 (6 decimals). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was held by Spark Executor 0x65d946e533748a998b1f0e430803e39a6388f7a1, SETTER_ROLE by 0x4eE67c8Db1BAa6ddE99d936C7D313B5d31e8fa38, and TAKER_ROLE by 0x92afd6F2385a90e44da3a8B60Fe36f6cBe1D8709. The verified implementation uses the same deposit-gated share-mint pattern; the USDT0 dependency is a separate LayerZero bridge representation and no bridge control mints spUSDT.

controls.label: Spark/Sky SubProxy upgrade governance (48-hour DSPause)
controls.capDescription: The SubProxy is the vault's sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member. Sky governance can replace the UUPS implementation or raise the deposit cap through the 48-hour DSPause path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, the SparkVault implementation authorized UUPS upgrades only for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, whose sole member was SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. Its arbitrary-execution path resolved through DSPauseProxy 0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB, owned by DSPause 0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3 with delay()=172800 and authority Sky Chief 0x929d9A1435662357F54AdcF64DcEE4d6b867a6f9. StarGuard's 604800 maxDelay is an execution-expiry window rather than a mandatory delay.

controls.label: Inherited Ethereum USDT token owner multisig

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, spUSDT vault 0xe2e7a17dff93280dec073c995595155283e3c372 was a UUPS proxy using SparkVault implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455. Its sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member was Spark SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. Arbitrary SubProxy execution flowed through DSPauseProxy and DSPause with a mandatory 172800-second delay under live Sky Chief governance; StarGuard's seven-day maxDelay was only an expiry bound. At Arbitrum block 495303977 (2026-08-16), the omitted spUSDT V2 vault 0x45d91340b3b7b96985a72b5c678f7d9e8d664b62 used implementation 0x282dafe8b97e2db5053761a4601ab2e1cb976318, had a 250,000,000 USDT0 deposit cap, and was administered by Spark Executor 0x65d946e533748a998b1f0e430803e39a6388f7a1 with SETTER_ROLE 0x4eE67c8Db1BAa6ddE99d936C7D313B5d31e8fa38 and TAKER_ROLE 0x92afd6F2385a90e44da3a8B60Fe36f6cBe1D8709. At Arbitrum block 495305504, Spark Receiver 0x212871A1C235892F86cAB30E937e18c94AEd8474 returned L1 authority 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4 and target Executor 0x65d946e533748a998b1f0e430803e39a6388f7a1; Executor delay() was 0 and gracePeriod() 604800 seconds, so this is not a timelock. Both vaults mint wrapper shares only against local deposits and do not create base USDT supply. The Arbitrum vault's USDT0 collateral is a separate LayerZero lock-and-mint representation of Tether's Ethereum USDT, not a bridged spUSDT representation. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-08-16: local share issuance remains deposit-gated and mutable through the respective native governance paths, while scored base-supply mint authority remains inherited from Tether. BDO reconciles Tether reserves quarterly; the latest available report covers 2026-03-31. Tether's El Salvador registration is not treated as prudential stablecoin supervision.
